description: Build the architecture, GO decision and evidence artifact tables and plot measured ANO5 tracks: pLDDT, AlphaMissense and pathogenic missense against TM segments, the SCRD and the 48-64 motif
code:
import json, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
P="prov"
plddt=pd.read_csv(f"{P}/ANO5_AF_plddt.csv")
path=pd.read_csv(f"{P}/ANO5_pathogenic_missense.csv")
am=pd.read_csv(f"{P}/ANO5_alphamissense.csv")
am["position"]=am.protein_variant.str.extract(r"^[A-Z](\d+)[A-Z]$").astype(int)
amm=am.groupby("position")["am_pathogenicity"].mean()
ppos=sorted(set(int(x) for x in path["pos"]))
TM={"TM1":(303,329),"TM2":(378,404),"TM3":(460,486),"TM4":(513,539),"TM5":(555,581),
    "TM6":(605,630),"TM7":(667,693),"TM8":(688,714),"TM9":(726,752),"TM10":(832,858)}
SCRD=(530,564); CA=[626,629,672,675,704,708]

arch=[dict(element="Cytosolic N-terminal disordered tail", start=1, end=65,
           basis="AlphaFold AF-Q75V66 v6, mean pLDDT 37.6", chimera="retained"),
      dict(element="Candidate basic-hydrophobic motif 48-64", start=48, end=64,
           basis="BH scan rank 1 of 897 windows", chimera="retained"),
      dict(element="Cytosolic N-terminal folded region", start=66, end=299,
           basis="mean pLDDT 84.9", chimera="retained")]
for n,(a,b) in TM.items():
    arch.append(dict(element=n, start=a, end=b,
        basis="ANO6 UniProt TM projected by BLOSUM62 global alignment (51.4% id)",
        chimera=("partly replaced" if not(b<SCRD[0] or a>SCRD[1]) else "retained")))
arch.append(dict(element="Scrambling domain SCRD", start=530, end=564,
                 basis="Whitlock 2018 PMID 30257928 Methods", chimera="REPLACED by mouse ANO1 554-588"))
arch.append(dict(element="Ca2+ site N626/E629/E672/E675/E704/D708", start=626, end=708,
                 basis="ANO1 ligand projection; CB-CB 5.7-12.0 A", chimera="retained"))
arch.append(dict(element="Cytosolic C-terminal region", start=861, end=913,
                 basis="C-terminal to TM10", chimera="retained"))
arch=pd.DataFrame(arch).sort_values("start")
arch["n_pathogenic_missense"]=[sum(a<=p<=b for p in ppos) for a,b in zip(arch.start,arch.end)]
arch["mean_AlphaMissense"]=[round(float(amm.loc[a:b].mean()),3) for a,b in zip(arch.start,arch.end)]
arch.to_csv(f"{P}/TABLE_ANO5_architecture_map.csv", index=False)
print(arch.to_string(index=False))

go=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(aspect="MF", term="GO:0017128 phospholipid scramblase activity", lead="retain, qualify as not required for the repair step",
      evidence="ANO515 (ANO5 530-564 -> ANO1 554-588) abolishes scrambling yet restores repair; PMID 30257928, 33496727"),
 dict(aspect="BP", term="GO:0001778 plasma membrane repair", lead="retain as core",
      evidence="ANO5-KO myofibre FM1-43 and laser-wounding defects; PMID 33496727"),
 dict(aspect="MF", term="GO:0005543 phospholipid binding (child GO:0005546 PI(4,5)P2 binding)", lead="do not add; computational lead only",
      evidence="BH scan rank 1/897 at 48-64, above MARCKS ED; no ANO5 lipid-binding assay exists"),
 dict(aspect="MF", term="protein binding, BVES/POPDC1", lead="avoid as final term; seek informative child after direct binding data",
      evidence="BioID2 plus co-IP mapped to the ANO5 N-terminus; PMID 34963485"),
 dict(aspect="CC", term="GO:0005789 ER membrane / GO:0005886 plasma membrane", lead="curator check of the localisation source",
      evidence="Determines whether 48-64 faces the cytosol at the wound site"),
 dict(aspect="MF", term="GO:0005509 calcium ion binding", lead="retain, with residue-level support",
      evidence="Six ligands chemically identical to ANO1; no pathogenic missense at any of them")])
go.to_csv(f"{P}/TABLE_ANO5_GO_decision.csv", index=False)

ev=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(pmid="30257928", evidence_type="construct / direct assay", stance="supports",
      claim_tested="Boundaries of the scrambling-defective chimera",
      key_finding="ANO515: ANO5 530-564 replaced by mouse ANO1 554-588 (reciprocal ANO151)",
      context="HEK293, codon-optimised human ANO5", confidence="high; verbatim from Methods"),
 dict(pmid="33496727", evidence_type="mutant phenotype", stance="supports",
      claim_tested="Scrambling-defective ANO5 still restores repair",
      key_finding="ANO5-1-5 rescues repair in ANO5-KO muscle, expressed below wild type",
      context="mouse myofibres, FM1-43", confidence="moderate; qualitative rescue, unequal expression"),
 dict(pmid="33496727", evidence_type="mutant phenotype", stance="supports",
      claim_tested="A residue in the retained N-tail is required for repair",
      key_finding="R58W patient myocytes take up 2.5x more FM1-43 at 2 min; ANO5-R58W-mCherry expresses but does not rescue",
      context="human patient myocytes; ANO5-KO fibres", confidence="high for R58W; one variant"),
 dict(pmid="34963485", evidence_type="interaction", stance="supports",
      claim_tested="The retained N-terminus mediates a protein contact",
      key_finding="ANO5-BioID2 recovers BVES and POPDC3, absent from ANO6 and MG53 controls; co-IP maps ANO5 N-terminus to BVES C-terminus",
      context="C2C12 myoblasts", confidence="moderate; proximity labelling plus co-IP, not direct binding"),
 dict(pmid="31825630", evidence_type="direct assay", stance="qualifies",
      claim_tested="Basic/aromatic repair-complex peptides bind anionic lipid",
      key_finding="AHNAK 5654-5673 inserts preferentially into negatively charged phospholipid monolayers",
      context="synthetic peptide, Langmuir and 31P ssNMR", confidence="high for AHNAK; extension to ANO5 is inference"),
 dict(pmid="22940583", evidence_type="structural", stance="competing",
      claim_tested="The same peptide class can instead be a protein-docking site",
      key_finding="AHNAK C-terminal peptide binds S100A10-annexin A2 at ~30 nM",
      context="X-ray, 3.5 A", confidence="high; shows sequence cannot assign lipid versus protein"),
 dict(pmid="31061173", evidence_type="mutant phenotype", stance="supports",
      claim_tested="An anoctamin can act without lipid transport",
      key_finding="ANO8 tethers ER/PM junctions required for STIM1-Orai1 coupling",
      context="HEK293/HeLa", confidence="moderate; different paralog, precedent only"),
 dict(pmid="26057829", evidence_type="direct assay", stance="supports",
      claim_tested="The SCRD is a transplantable 35-residue scrambling element",
      key_finding="TMEM16F SCRD transfer confers scrambling on TMEM16A",
      context="HEK293", confidence="high"),
 dict(pmid="computed here", evidence_type="computational", stance="qualifies",
      claim_tested="48-64 is a deeply conserved functional island",
      key_finding="55.3% mean ortholog identity versus 80.2% for the SCRD; no match in 25 full-length models",
      context="190 vertebrate ANO5 sequences, 188 TrEMBL", confidence="moderate; automatic gene models"),
 dict(pmid="computed here", evidence_type="computational", stance="qualifies",
      claim_tested="Disease variants avoid the replaced SCRD",
      key_finding="SCRD 530-564 holds 4 pathogenic missense in 42 annotated positions (9.5%), the highest regional density, and the highest mean AlphaMissense (0.720)",
      context="UniProt/EBI variation, 1297 missense, 51 pathogenic", confidence="moderate; ascertainment bias"),
 dict(pmid="computed here", evidence_type="computational", stance="supports",
      claim_tested="Pathogenic burden concentrates in the transmembrane domain",
      key_finding="TMD 300-860 39/673 (5.8%, OR 3.14, p=3.0e-4); region 66-299 5/308 (1.6%, OR 0.34, p=0.018); C-term 861-913 0/78",
      context="same variant set", confidence="moderate")])
ev.to_csv(f"{P}/TABLE_ANO5_evidence_matrix.csv", index=False)
print("\nwrote TABLE_ANO5_architecture_map.csv, TABLE_ANO5_GO_decision.csv, TABLE_ANO5_evidence_matrix.csv")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(3,1, figsize=(13.5,7.4), sharex=True, gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1.1,1,0.8]})
for k in range(3):
    for a,b in TM.values(): ax[k].axvspan(a,b, color="#cfe3f7", zorder=0)
    ax[k].axvspan(*SCRD, color="#1b9e77", alpha=.5, zorder=1)
    ax[k].axvspan(48,64, color="#d95f02", alpha=.55, zorder=1)
ax[0].plot(plddt.resi, plddt.plddt, lw=.8, color="#222222")
ax[0].axhline(50, color="#aa0000", lw=.7, ls="--"); ax[0].set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT")
ax[0].set_title("Human ANO5 Q75V66: measured architecture, per-residue constraint and pathogenic missense")
ax[1].plot(amm.index, amm.values, lw=.7, color="#3b3b7a"); ax[1].set_ylabel("mean AlphaMissense")
ax[2].vlines(ppos, 0, 1, color="#b2182b", lw=1.5)
for c in CA: ax[2].plot(c, 0.45, marker="v", color="#7570b3", ms=7)
ax[2].set_ylim(0,1.45); ax[2].set_yticks([]); ax[2].set_xlabel("residue"); ax[2].set_ylabel("pathogenic\nmissense")
ax[2].text(56,1.12,"48-64 motif (retained)", color="#a34700", fontsize=8, ha="center")
ax[2].text(547,1.12,"SCRD 530-564 (replaced in ANO515)", color="#116b52", fontsize=8, ha="center")
ax[2].text(700,0.25,"Ca2+ ligands", color="#7570b3", fontsize=8, ha="center")
ax[2].text(120,1.12,"blue bands: TM1-TM10", color="#2f6ea8", fontsize=8, ha="center")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
